name: White Simulation
source:
In an unknown place, you met a strange guy. You will have to find out where you are and who this stranger is. Also, why this unfamiliar place so familiar to you?

[Translated from [url=https://doedalus.itch.io/white-simulation]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个不知名的地方，你遇见了一名奇怪的男子。你必须弄清自己身在何处，以及这个陌生人是谁。还有，这个陌生的地方，为何让你觉得如此熟悉？

[译自[url=https://doedalus.itch.io/white-simulation]itch.io[/url]]
